profile.name: RAM PRAKASH
profile.tagline: I create bold, purposeful visual experiences that help brands communicate clearly and stand out.
profile.bio: Creative and results-driven Senior Graphic Designer with 9 years of professional experience in graphic design, multimedia, branding, visual communication, and digital content creation. Proven ability to transform concepts and business requirements into engaging, visually compelling designs that effectively communicate brand messages and enhance audience engagement. Seeking to contribute creative expertise, strategic thinking, and strong design capabilities to an innovative and forward-thinking organization, while delivering high-quality visual solutions that support brand growth and business success.

projects.title: KANSO
projects.description: A calm, tactile identity for a contemporary botanical sparkling tea, combining warm materials with a precise visual system.
projects.approach: A confident wordmark, modular botanical symbols and a cream, black and vermilion palette create strong recognition across packaging and campaigns.

projects.title: SOLSTICE LAB
projects.description: An optimistic mineral-suncare identity balancing clinical trust with the visual energy of summer.
projects.approach: Cobalt blue communicates protection while warm yellow introduces sunlight and optimism. A modular grid keeps education and product messaging clear.

projects.title: SORA BAKEHOUSE
projects.description: A warm neighbourhood bakery identity inspired by handcrafted pastry and quiet daily rituals.
projects.approach: A soft wordmark, cocoa brown and dusty rose palette, tactile paper and intimate photography create a calm, recognisable world.

projects.title: POSTER STUDIES
projects.description: Experimental poster directions exploring music culture, aviation systems and street-fashion energy.
projects.approach: Oversized type, collage, halftone texture and strong image hierarchy create three distinct visual voices.

projects.title: SURREAL COMPOSITES
projects.description: A collection of cinematic advertising composites built around impossible spaces and controlled atmosphere.
projects.approach: Lighting, scale, masking and color grading connect unrelated source elements into believable visual worlds.

projects.title: FORM & FIELD
projects.description: A fictional cultural journal system spanning covers, editorial spreads, invitations and typographic collateral.
projects.approach: A disciplined Swiss-inspired grid is balanced with warm paper, oversized type and restrained red details.

projects.title: NEXA GRID
projects.description: A future-facing social campaign toolkit for AI, climate and connected technology.
projects.approach: Dark cinematic imagery, electric orange accents and modular headlines create immediate feed recognition.
